clauses.title: Writer selection
requires: For exact PR `autofix`, `tidd-autofix-worker` is the mandatory and sole correction writer/publisher.
**Do not fall back to another worker**
An owner request for any other worker is a CL-D30 contract change: stop before mutation, end the exact-autofix run, and do not resume it.
that delegation receives no CL-D30 authority and does not make the exact-autofix writer replaceable
